picks.name: Brushed Shetland Crew Neck, navy
picks.why: Your office and date-night outfits still have no knit, and this is a proper winter one at 45% off. A regular-fit raglan crew in brushed Scottish lambswool, so it has texture without bulk and the sleeve sits naturally long. Wear it over a tee with the fawn chinos and brown Docs, or with the 502s and Sambas under the Ashby.

picks.name: AIRism Cotton Crew Neck T-Shirt, olive
picks.why: A plain tee is the base of three outfits and you still don't own one. Regular fit, standard length, smooth cotton face that sits flat under knits and overshirts, no logo. Olive goes tonal with the Ashby or under the navy crew, with the 502s or navy chinos.

picks.name: 3001 Overshirt, army green
picks.why: No overshirt yet for the everyday outfit, and this is under target at £59.50 (was £85). A classic chore-coat cut in heavy cotton with a regular body and patch pockets, no branding. Layer it over a tee or the grey marl sweat with the 502s and Sambas, or the navy chinos and brown Docs.
